facts.fact: The article claims that 90% of published customer advisory board guides assume enterprise budgets for perks like travel and venues.
facts.quote: 90% of published guides assume enterprise budgets for perks like travel and venues

facts.fact: The article cites an unnamed 'discussion of SMB-friendly CAB models' claiming a micro-CAB of 4 to 5 customers meeting monthly by video can deliver 3x higher retention than traditional annual boards.
facts.quote: micro-CAB of 4 to 5 customers meeting monthly by video can deliver 3x higher retention than traditional annual boards

facts.fact: According to Insight Partners' guidance, 62% of B2B startups now use customer advisory boards for sales validation and go-to-market strategy, not just product input.
facts.quote: 62% of B2B startups now use CABs for sales validation and go-to-market strategy, not just product input

facts.fact: According to Insight Partners' guidance, boards focused on how to sell to target buyers generate 2.4x more revenue growth than boards focused purely on product roadmaps.
facts.quote: how to sell to target buyers generate 2.4x more revenue growth

facts.fact: UserVoice's CAB best practices, as cited by the article, recommend inviting advisory board participants from the 20% of customers that generate 80% of revenue.
facts.quote: Invite participants from the 20 percent of customers that generate 80 percent of revenue

facts.fact: According to CRV's guidance, industry best practice is a customer advisory board size of 8 to 12 members.
facts.quote: Industry best practices call for a CAB size of 8 to 12 members meeting quarterly for 90 minutes

facts.fact: According to CRV's guidance, industry best practice is for customers to hold 80% of talk time in a customer advisory board meeting.
facts.quote: with 80% customer talk time and internal presentations limited to less than 20% of the meeting

facts.fact: According to CRV's guidance, industry best practice limits internal presentations to less than 20% of a customer advisory board meeting.
facts.quote: internal presentations limited to less than 20% of the meeting

facts.fact: According to Opus Agency's CAB guidance, as cited on the page, weak post-meeting follow-up can drive a 50% higher drop-off rate in later quarters.
facts.unit: % higher drop-off rate in later quarters
facts.quote: weak follow-up can drive a 50% higher drop-off rate in later quarters, according to Opus Agency's CAB guidance
